# Chapter 1: Part 1

Emmett was pissed. He had just gotten back from the food court at a nearby space station when he realized an error in the ship's navigational system. Acceleration and liftoff were fine, but the general steering and pathfinding of the ship were off. Emmett would have been fine with this happening had the crew owned their ship for a GUY or so, however the ship was only a few weeks out from the stockrooms of Fleetshup-7. The Squoatling underwent the tedious process of unscrewing the double screws (screws embedded in screws) of the navigational panel and checked around for any broken fuses. Instead, he was met with a nice surprise.

"[Oh, fucking hell.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

In the compartment, a mess was stowed. Dirty tissues, used condoms, rings, physical Ducketts, and other objects of vice revealed themselves. In the place where the navigation and pathfinding fuses used to be, two packets of liquid cheese were found. This was the last straw. Emmett stood up from his kneeling position and stomped his way to the captain's quarters.

"[Seth! Get out here right this instant!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" There was no response, even after multiple requests.

"[This has gotten out of hand.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett had to push the door open due to the pile of clothing in front of it. Clothing was strewn all throughout the floor, increasing in concentration as the eye continued to Seth's bed. He was asleep with two holographic girls, each with an obvious fluid projected in its midsection. The Kid was getting impatient.

"[Wake up, dipshit!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" This got the attention of the unconscious Seth, causing him to open up his eyes and unnaturally bolt straight upwards.

"[Emmett, is that you?]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}"

He was startled from Seth's awakening, but Emmett stood his ground.

"[Why did you leave all of your fucking sex toys all in the navigation system? This is the third ship you've ruined this GUY!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Seth, having been rudely awakened from his slumber, was grouchy.

"[Leave me alone, furbing. I need somewhere to keep my stuff.]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}"

"[Dirty condoms and wet tissues? Are you serious right now? That's trash!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Seth got out of his bed and stretched, towering above the little Squoatling.

"[This is my ship. I choose where things go. Fuck off.]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}" Emmett put his hands on his hips, unaffected by the height difference between them.

"[I can't fly correctly with your shitty sex supplies always in the way. Get them out and move them in here, man.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

Seth furrowed his brow, pausing in what little rational thought he had. This pause further upset Emmett, seeing as how his friend was acting like an imbecile.

"[So? Going to get rid of your crap for me?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[How about, I get rid of you and your crap for me, asshole!]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}" Suddenly, Seth picked up the lightweight goat and quite literally threw him out of his room, Emmett slamming into the door across the hallway. Emmett, panting for breath due to the impact, scurried to get up. Sanya and Hector suddenly appeared from the entrance behind Emmett, having been working on some sort of herbal concoction.

"[What's going on?]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Sanya witnessed a drunkenly mad Seth storming towards The Kid with hostility. She jumped in between them without thought, hoping to protect the weakling out of maternal instinct.

"[You're not hurting him!]{Hector}" Hector ran back into his room to grab his syringe gun, hoping to subdue the raging elf. Meanwhile, Seth reached the floran and stopped.

"[Get out of the way, Sanya. I need to teach this kid a lesson.]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}"

"[What the hell is wrong with you?]{Sanya Dreadflower}" Seth suddenly shoved the plant, causing her to fall upon her back.

"[Someone needs to learn their fucking boundaries.]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}" With the help of Sanya's distraction, Emmett fled into his room.

"[He's absolutely mad!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett was on edge, struggling to find his satchel. He dug into the little clutter around the underside of his bed and tunneled under the bed, finding the bag. Out of paranoia of Seth's appearance, he scurried completely beneath his bed and opened up his satchel. Along with family pictures and his inheritance, The Kid took out a cylindrical canister. He unscrewed the lid and dipped two fingers into it, finding a paste-like material. He hesitated. The Squoatling had only used it once, and even then the medications had devastating effects. He had only one way to take out this menace: The Crave. Staring at his barreled fingers, he raised them above his head to his horns.

"[Oh no you don't!]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}" What wizardry was this? Seth, having come into the room, dragged Emmett from one of his hooves out of the underside of the bed. The canister was left underneath, but Emmett was able to latch onto his satchel.

"[Fuck off, lead-head.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[I've had to take care of you for nine GUYs and this is how you repay me? By disgracing me and my practices?]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}" Emmett tried to spit at his capturer out of disgust, but due to his upside-down position, he missed and hit his own snout.

"[You need to learn what it's like to live on your own, twat.]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}"

Seth carried Emmett by his hoof all the way to the airlock chamber--an impressive feat. Little did he know, a certain doctor stalked behind him.

"[I was starting to like you too, Emmett. What a shame.]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}"

"[The fuck do you mean?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett concealed his terror. He was about to be airlocked out of his own ship. A mutiny in the making--aside from the fact that he was merely the co-captain. He was dropped in the airlock chamber, and before he could get up, the doorway sealed itself. Rock bottom.

"[Any last words, furbing?]{Seth Im'Kin'ki}" Emmett looked in his satchel for answers. He had nothing left. He was about to be pummelled into the infinite abyss. Emmett prayed for the first time in ages. Prayed to Squoatanity. Praised his Squoat.

"[Get a life.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

Seth was just about to press the airlock when a well-shot, high-concentration tranquilizer dart stabbed into his neck. His fall was unpredictable, however. Seth's hand pressed the button right as he was knocked unconscious.

# Chapter 2: Part 2

Nothingness. Void. Vacuum. These were all that Emmett could see as he helplessly floated away from his ship. He was lucky to even be alive. Before Seth pushed the button, Emmett found something in one of his late father's books. Titled, *The Fiends Without Squoat*, there was a small present embedded in a rectangular hole in the first few pages. Labeled "Do Not Use Unless Necessary", the dead grub in the pages was meant to be crushed in one's hands, as described later in the story. Emmett crushed it right before he was discharged. His body was encompassed by an insect-like exoskeleton. (Emmett practically looked like he was in a TRON™ suit, but with more organic and insectoid armor.) This exoskeleton insulated him from the perilous depths of space, and in addition, respirated him with the help of an oxygen generator. The suit was old and discharged however; the power that kept him alive was leached from his communications system.

The Kid felt paralyzed and dizzy. He wasn't used to actually being in space, let alone uncontrollably drifting within it. He was also afraid he was going to puke from the head rush he was receiving. His experience was fading quickly. Rather than being upset at Seth, he soon became bored. There was quite literally nothing he could do. With no forces holding him down, he was doomed.

That was, until he saw a ship in the distance. It was not his own, but rather, a small cruiser. The vehicle was dashing towards him, to the point that he felt as if they were bound to save him. Alas, this was not the case. The small passenger ship sped past him within feet of his face, causing him to yaw clockwise. Now he was spinning on two separate planes. Delightful. It wasn't much longer until a fleet sprouted from behind the ship, obviously in pursuit. His hopes came up again. Of all the ships chasing the getaway, one of them slowed down to accommodate Emmett's position. He was rescued. With the use of a tractor beam, the Squoatling was dragged to safety.

Upon entering the ship, Emmett immediately fell to the floor. His now increased weight due to his bugsuit along with his newfound gravity caused him to drop.

"[Must've been a hell of a reason why you'd be deserted from your own ship, huh?]{Troupe Ringmaster}" Emmett tried to take off his helmet before realizing the anonymity it granted him.

"[I was kicked out of my own ship.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[You're lucky to be alive then.]{Troupe Ringmaster}"

"[Yeah.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett pushed himself up and slowly propped himself on the stranger's passenger seat.

"[Are you guys chasing the speeder down?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The man patted his passenger seat and began to accelerate; the entrance from whence Emmett entered sealed itself tightly.

"[This guy stole our most prized possession after gaining our trust. We're a troupe, you see.]{Troupe Ringmaster}" Ah, the infamous space troupes. So delicate in performance but just as dangerous and unpredictable, if not more than, a bounty hunting clan. Emmett liked how this actor was not inquisitive about his being, but rather focused on his goal. He took his place in the passenger's seat and watched as they zoomed towards their target.

"[Need me to man the turrets? I've had experience.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Look, I trust you just as much as any other stranger I pick up in the middle of nowhere. I can't afford that artifact being blown to pieces though. Just sit tight.]{Troupe Ringmaster}" Emmett uncomfortably shifted in his seat, feeling unsatisfied in the moment. He decided to recollect his thoughts on his situation. Was he really in the wrong? Did he infringe on Seth's boundaries? The more he thought about it, the more guilt he felt. Maybe he shouldn't have been so upset. Maybe he should've just picked up his guardian's trash. Maybe he--

"[HOLY SHIT!]{Troupe Ringmaster}" The ringmaster was in immense shock as he found his own crew being blown to pieces, one by one. Their assailant was getting away, escaping into the depths of an armada.

"[What's going on?!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The Kid looked up and gasped. The blue insignia on each ship told it all. It was the Llamanians. The ones who ruined his childhood. The ones who killed his parents. The ones who eradicated his home planet. After being shipped out of his vessel, Emmett knew what he must do. He couldn't hide anymore.

"[Sir, do you have any firepower?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The man was in the process of requesting backup from other space troupes.

"[Are you insane? That would be suicide! We need to get out of here!]{Troupe Ringmaster}" At that point, The Kid took off his helmet, revealing to the ringmaster his Squoatling qualities. Emmett took a white ribbon bow and tied it around his forehead. A sign of putting one’s intentions over their own body.

"[This is my calling.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The ringmaster nodded without further argumentation. He was knowledgeable about Llama-Squoat warfare, considering that it was broadcast throughout the galaxy nonstop for a week. The leader tossed Emmett a Ryno-45, a plasma-based shotgun with a higher-than-average range, along with some spare ammo.

"[Anywhere you want me to launch you?]{Troupe Ringmaster}" The ringmaster had a newfound confidence for him. The Squoatling put on his helmet and pointed towards the largest vessel, the mothership.

"[May Squoat have mercy on us all.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

The ship turned around and shot Emmett through the airlock. He was curled up in a ball and was cannoned along with trash; he was nearly undetectable in this position. The armada started to broadcast a message over all comm frequencies in the region:

"[TAKE YOUR LITTER BACK OUT OR BE SUBJECT TO EXECUTION BY THE LLAMA EMPIRE.]{Llamanian Armada}" The troupe leader then was acquainted with hundreds of other mismatched ships, overmatching the number of ships in the armada by half. Suddenly, the ships, rather than surrendering, started to fire upon the Llamas. A warzone began to form, along with casualties, powerful ship weaponry, and stray ammunition. Although Emmett's trash pile was mostly unaffected, a few beams were close to hitting him. As he reached the mothership, he latched onto it and strafed his way along a convenient ledge to a hangar bay. (Unfortunately, a banana peel did not make the journey.)

Emmett took his weapon out and recharged it with a battery pack. The troupe leader only gave him a few, so he needed to stay careful on his supply. He took a few deep breaths and finally entered. Immediately, the Squoatling was met with hostility.

"[Hey! Don't move!]{Llamanian Soldier}" The Llamanians on his left were well armed, whereas the one on his right was trying to apprehend him. Emmett flipped off the safety of his gun and held the trigger out of view for a moment.

"[I said 'Don't move'! We will shoot!]{Llamanian Soldier}" As the Llama finished speaking, Emmett aimed at two of the men on his left and released. The two of them fell, considering they were close enough to receive a concentrated blast of ultra-heated matter. The third fired at the trespasser, but the blast was absorbed by Emmett's shell. He took out the remaining two Llamas and noticed that the crevices of his apparel were now glowing green. As it turns out, the concentrated energy of the laser his opponent shot charged his armor to a functional state. Emmett took out his satchel then and quickly skimmed his father's book; he learned the suit's few enhancements through the story.

Emmett stomped twice, causing him to propel forward at an uncontrollable speed. His helmet helped keep his head intact as he burst through metal walls, piping, machinery, and occasionally, people. He was only stopped whenever he hit an equivalently armored opponent. The figure caught and slammed Emmett on the ground after she suffered the recoil of the shell's propulsion. His propulsion powered off, and the crevices of his suit glowed to indicate low battery.

"[Hah! Imbeciles like you make me want to weep for their deaths.]{Josephine}" The figure, clad in a power suit with a Llamanian insignia upon it, drew a phaseblade. The figure quickly, before Emmett could react, swiped at Emmett's side. The blade had no effect.

"[Typical.]{Josephine}" The figure's blade then switched to a sharp, metallic one. She tossed him a similar weapon, insisting that he put away his gun.

"[Let us dance.]{Josephine}" Emmett looked at his Ryno, and promptly aimed at her. She swiped the gun out of his hands with her sword.

"[Pitiful, uncultured beast.]{Josephine}" His opponent immediately attacked, swiping at his right arm. Emmett then evaded, ducking down to grab his sword.

"[Not fair!]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[What isn't fair is your lack of civility.]{Josephine}" It slashed again, which Emmett accidentally parried; he did not counter her attack. Emmett lacked any experience with a sword, however, he played along, constantly backing up to reach for his gun.

"[Don't think you can get away so easily!]{Josephine}" The being forcefully slashed into his shoulder, breaking into the shell. The Kid groaned in pain, fleeing by sliding away. He grabbed his gun and hastily aimed, hitting only her non-dominant arm. The being hissed in agony.

"[Oh, you want to play dirty? I can play dirty.]{Josephine}" The armored figure imitated Emmett's clumsiness, walking towards him. He backed up, having coincidentally run out of shots in his current battery pack. As Tawfeek reached the wall, he fumbled with reloading, having dropped his sword when grabbing his gun. The being reached within a foot of him, and pressed a button on the side of her helmet before mockingly falling forward and headbutting him. The impact felt like an anvil. Emmett was certainly out for the count.

"[Loser can't even defend himself.]{Josephine}"

When Emmett awoke, he was stereotypically bound to a chair. His head was pounding with pain. The Kid looked up to find the one who bested him earlier.

"[Finally awake? I want to see the fear in your eyes as I behead you.]{Josephine}" This was it. He had no way to get out of this one. Emmett was too weak to break out of the bonds and he had no way to defend himself, if that mattered. He felt that paranoia from earlier. He thought of how this could've been avoided if he only took out Seth's trash. Now, his life's goal was doomed. He was doomed. The whole Squoatling race was doomed.

"[Any last words?]{Josephine}"

"[I would spit on you if I could.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The being laughed a little from his comment and afterwards attempted to take off his helmet. It didn't realize how tight the cap was on his head. Eventually, the helmet was off, and the bruised face of a defeated Squoatling with a silly white band revealed itself. The being hesitated. This hesitation was so strong, it made it drop its executioner's tool. Emmett looked to the being in its face, raising his brow a little. His executioner took off her helmet as well, showing to Emmett a purple and white collage of fur. She was another Squoatling.

# Chapter 3: Part 3

"[Wait, tell me again. Why are you with the Llamas?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The purplish-white Squoatling sighed. It was awkward enough to tell her own kind why she was with their exterminators, let alone twice.

"[Look...Remember when a group of scholars were sent off to Yamax before the war?]{Josephine}" Emmett, still bound, nodded.

"[Yeah. They were foreign exchange students with the Llamanians.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Precisely. I was one of those scholars. When the war started, they immediately locked us up, with little rations for the ten of us. We still studied with the other Llamanians, but we were tested much more cruelly.]{Josephine}" Emmett was getting uncomfortable due to his wrists being tied. As she spoke, he began to try and slip out of the rope.

"[Low grades meant torture. We were whipped, branded, and starved for low grades. It was terrible. People started dropping like flies. In three weeks, we fell from ten to eight. Eight to five; five to three. In the end, only I prevailed. Instead of refusing to answer loyalty questions on tests like the others, I got them correct. I was shunned. Exiled from our little group from Vortox.]{Josephine}" Emmett finally had his wrists undone, but out of sincerity, he still listened on.

"[From then on, I was put into less academic education over time. For a three GUY period, I was put through rigorous combat training by the Llamanians, to the point of life or death. They tried to kill me at almost every moment they could get. Only at night could I have a resting phase. As time progressed however, my perseverance began to show. Their tactics were less and less creative, and I always expected the worst. I came to be respected. Feared for my survivability. 'Above the low life qualities the others portrayed', as the Captain stated.]{Josephine}"

"[I see. You were practically forced into servitude.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Or I would have perished, yes.]{Josephine}" Emmett frowned at her last comment.

"[What will you do now?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Josephine took out a pocket knife and started to cut his bonds.

"[I'm unsure. We need to get you out of here though. I'm not seeing one of my kin die on my watch. Wait a moment.]{Josephine}" Josephine looked up at him.

"[You could have escaped that whole time, couldn't you?]{Josephine}" Emmett swallowed a little.

"[Yeah, I could.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Why didn't you? If you weren't a Squoatling I totally would have ended you.]{Josephine}" Emmett paused for a long moment, looking for the words to say. "[It's okay if you don't want to answer. We just met like an hour ago--]{Josephine}"

"[I felt hopeless then. That was, until I saw who you were.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The woman furrowed her brow in confusion.

"[Wait, huh?]{Josephine}"

"[Squoat amour, Fina. Furgaz squaleiz.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" (In this context, this pretty much meant, "[Squoat gives his kindness to you, Josephine. I love you for who you are.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He didn't mean love in the romantic sense, obviously.) Emmett stood up and smiled coyly; he stretched casually. On the other hand, Josephine covered her face. She was blushing from his statement. It felt like a millennium ago that she would have heard such heartfelt and cherishing words.

"[Are you okay?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[I don't know how to feel.]{Josephine}"

"[What do you mean?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Just, everything.]{Josephine}"

Emmett waited for Josephine to get out of the restroom an hour later. They had agreed upon a plan to get him out of there: deception. Emmett would put himself into her armor and make his way to the escape pods. Josephine, on the other hand, would go on a different route. It was the best strategy they got on short notice.

"[What's taking her so long? She's just changing clothes]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett mumbled to himself. He went up next to the door and knocked on it.

"[Just a second!]{Josephine}" She sounded like she was stressed from her speech. Rather than to provoke anything, The Kid backtracked and whistled a soft tune to himself. Soon, the female Squoatling was out.

"[Here. Sorry I took so long.]{Josephine}"

"[You're fine.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Josephine was in a skin-tight Llamanian suit fitted for a Squoatling. It was general wear for those aboard the ship. She was visibly frowning, pulling at her collar.

"[What's wrong? Need to talk?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett was more concerned about her state over the suggestive qualities of her suit. Still, his eyes wandered here and there.

"[Just...Nothing. The sooner we get you out, the sooner I'll feel better.]{Josephine}" She tossed him her suit, which was surprisingly lighter than what he thought. The Kid took off his shell with little ease in front of her.

"[Need any help?]{Josephine}"

"[I got it.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He then slipped right into her armor and fitted the helmet on.

"[Sheesh, this stinks]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett grumbled.

"[Yeah, I know. The Llamas stink too...I mean by odor, that is.]{Josephine}" Tawfeek tilted his head at this comment.

"[Just get on out of here. I'll meet you at the end.]{Josephine}"

Emmett uncomfortably walked the western passage of the mothership, making little contact with the officers he passed by. It felt like the journey would have taken forever as he considered the length of the ship. Thankfully, he had much to contemplate upon. He was really excited that he finally found a female Squoatling. Although he was definitely getting ahead of himself, her being gave him a newfound hope. But he was also worried for her. Josephine was loyal to the Llamanians. She made herself a reputation with them, and they kept her alive for six GUYs. It was as if the Llamas were her Seth.

"[Oh, Seth.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" It must have been a day since he was launched from the ship. A day since he was a pilot. A day since he even ate. Although he wished to be back at home, Seth's temper tantrum did bring him to the girl of his dreams. (That wasn't saying much though. He just wanted any female Squoatling.) Emmett stopped for a moment and leaned on a wall.

"[Y'know, this place isn't so bad.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[I'd hope you would think so.]{Tall Llamanian}" A tall Llamanian with shades and battle armor appeared in front of him.

"[Hey babe. I've been looking for you everywhere.]{Tall Llamanian}" It seemed that her helmet had a voice modulator in it! Or at least Josephine planned ahead and snuck it on there while in the restroom.

"[Oh. Hey.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[I was just going to chill at the Brozone for a bit. Want to swing by at around five for some...]{Tall Llamanian}" The Llamanian started to air thrust his pelvis. Emmett wanted to puke. He just showed the guy a thumbs up and stood away from the wall.

"[Grreat. See you then, Tiger.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett then learned that he really needed to get going.

Josephine, on the other hand, had her own thoughts alongside her long and uneventful journey on the eastside. She asked herself questions that revolved around her standing with the Llamanians and her true colors. The other exchange students shunned her for doing as she was told. They felt as if it was better to die for what they loved than to live to follow a different leader. Did she really follow the Llamanians? Surely she did; she followed their plans and their rules. But did it really make her a true Llamanian? She still followed Squoat, albeit she prayed little due to Llamanian philosophy. And also, she found herself loathing her difference amongst the Llamas. She wanted someone to relate to. What about Squemfet?

"[He's a cute guy, but I'm unsure of his deal.]{Josephine}" Squosafina spoke this aloud unintentionally as she passed by an open-door cafe. She was looked at as if she were crazy. This further proved her Squoatanity. She wasn't even allowed to speak to herself without getting weird looks from the Llamas.

"[Hey, Josephine!]{Drill Sergeant}" Her drill sergeant bumped into her from behind.

"[Oh, hey--]{Josephine}"

"[Where's your armor? You know it's mandatory to wear it around the ship!]{Drill Sergeant}"

"[I, um--]{Josephine}"

"[You're going to be late for a meeting at this rate! Get the fuck ready or I'm reporting your tardiness to General Guak.]{Drill Sergeant}" Shit! She knew she had forgotten something. Josephine really needed to get to the escape pods now. She could not face another strike on her record!

The two reunited in the room before the escape pods, with Josephine embracing Emmett.

"[I'm so glad you made it here safely.]{Josephine}" She hugged him tightly. Emmett did not think she would react like this, feeling a little awkward. Before he could hug back, Josephine realized what she was doing and tried to get rid of the tenderness of the moment.

"[I'm holding you like this to pull off my armor, by the way.]{Josephine}" Emmett sighed with relief, taking off the helmet and slipping out of her breastplate, gloves, and greaves.

"[It was really hot in there. How do you do it?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[There's an air conditioner in here, you know.]{Josephine}" She pressed a little button causing a soft fan to spin. Emmett now felt stupid.

"[That's unimportant though, we need to see if the coast is clear.]{Josephine}" Josephine put on her helmet and peered around the corner.

"[Shit.]{Josephine}"

"[What?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[I forgot there's a security card reader in place.]{Josephine}"

"[What would happen if we ran through it?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[The alarms would go off.]{Josephine}" She was not wrong either. The Llamanians were very strict with access procedures on the mothership.

"[What would happen if you got caught?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Josephine lowered her head, signifying guilt.

"[I think this is my second to last strike. They would probably take away my grass privileges for a week, too.]{Josephine}" Emmett mentally gasped in horror.

"[That's terrible!]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Well, how are we going to get you out of here?]{Josephine}" Emmett looked over to his partner with sincerity.

"[Jump the alarm with me.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[What?]{Josephine}" She was surprised.

"[Come and escape with me. You'll be free. And safe...]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[I can't, I don't think--]{Josephine}"

"[And not alone.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

This last statement hit the purple Squoatling hard. She was finally given the opportunity to return to her own kind, to live life once more as a free Goat-Dog. She still was uncertain.

"[Do you want me to come?]{Josephine}"

"[It would make me the happiest Squoatling in existence, Squosafina.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" She took off her helmet and looked him directly in his yellow, horizontal eyes.

"[Furgaz squaleiz, Fet.]{Josephine}" Emmett finally hugged back, resting his ear on her shoulder. She acknowledged the tender feeling and replicated it, tearing up a little in the process.

"[Intruder!]{Llamanian Guard}" Emmett looked over Josephine's shoulder, seeing three armed guards. Suddenly, Josephine stood up.

"[Sorry for this, Squemfet.]{Josephine}" She suddenly picked Emmett up and charged through the card reader, starting the alarm through the mothership.

"[INTRUDER ALERT IN THE ESCAPE REGION! ALL SECURITY PERSONNEL REPORT TO THE ESCAPE REGION!]{Mothership Intercom}" The three charged their arms up, with the leader hesitant to shoot. He saw her grow into who he believed she was: a bloodthirsty and cold-hearted killer.

"[Don't do this, Josie, you know I don't want to hurt you.]{Regimald}" Right as Emmett heard this voice, his face was knocked straight into the glass of a pod. He was out due to Josephine. Again.

"[I'm sorry, Regimald. I'm not a Llama. I never was! And I never will be!]{Josephine}" Right as she pressed the "OPEN" button on the pod, Regimald shot a dart in her arm. He was giving his only semblance of a daughter a chance to leave with the intruder.

"[If anyone shoots her or the intruder, you'll have to answer to me.]{Regimald}" Josephine quickly, yet sluggishly, started up the pod. She dropped Emmett on the floor and mouthed a "[thank you]{Josephine}" to her true Seth. Further troops came into the scene. The deserter pressed the ignition, causing the doors to shut. However, as the doors were closing, one of the newcomer security guards shot her in the thigh.

"[What the fuck, private!]{Regimald}" Josephine was downed, her groans negated by the severity of the alarm. She then was put to sleep from the concentration of the dart.

"[Rules are rules, Regimald.]{Llamanian Private}" Right as the escape pod left, a gun fight brewed on the Llamanian mothership.

# Chapter 4: Finale

The escape pod whizzed through space, past a barrage of lasers and the ongoing ship battle between the space troupes and the Llamas. Although it was only coincidence, the pod was unharmed as it left the battle scene. Josephine initially sent it to coordinates that were not under Llamanian jurisdiction, however, the pod seemed to have a mind of its own; the thrusters of the pod were possibly tampered with. It was Emmett's nature. Of course something shitty was bound to happen.

"[Ah, shit.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett woke up with his mouth foaming with blood. Apparently the impact with the glass was too much for his fragile stature to handle. The Kid spit up a tooth, which appeared to be the cause of his bleeding.

"[At least it was only a tooth.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He put his hands up to his lower jaw and checked for any damage, adjusting it as he needed. Luckily, Squoatling teeth were regenerative. He picked up his dislodged tooth and inspected it out of curiosity.

"[I guess no meat for me for a while.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" It was one of his few canines.

Right as Emmett took a stand, the vessel dived downward, causing him to stagger. He was dragged to the console of the pod forcibly, causing him to hit his sensitive horns against it. The unconscious Josephine also gravitated towards him, essentially sandwiching him in his position. Emmett ground the rest of his teeth in pain.

"[Ugh.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He pulled himself up and noticed a hole in his partner's armor.

"[Josephine...?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The Kid gently shook her before realizing she was out cold. Awkwardly, he pulled off the legs of her armor. In her right thigh was a wound an inch in diameter; a huge bullet was in her leg.

"[Damn, what happened here?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" He looked around for any cutting tools, aside from her sword. (Emmett did not want to hurt her any further.) He stuck his ear to her chest to ensure she was still breathing well. As he did this, the Squoatling took out his satchel, hoping to find something. Unfortunately, the satchel was not the cure-all as he previously had thought; the only helpful thing he found was his Squoat doll.

"[I think I might need to get my hooves dirty...]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

Emmett ripped the hole wider, feeling embarrassed about his position. When he felt the hole was decent enough, he put his digits to her fur, pulling it away to reveal her injury.

"[Oh man, that's in deep.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett put his head up to the hole to see it better. The bullet must have been embedded at least a centimeter in her thigh. He inhaled before trying to take out the ammunition. Emmett was disgusted. He did not like this one bit. Inside, he was hurting; he felt the pain he could have been causing her. After a few minutes of digging within her, he jumped.

"[What the fuck, Squemfet!]{Josephine}" Josephine bolted up, causing Emmett to fall back.

"[Don't- Don't touch that... Shit.]{Josephine}" She stared at her thigh, panting.

"[I was just trying to help!]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett was ignorant, blind to the fact that he could have potentially killed her through blood loss.

"[Squemfet, don't take out bullets unless you're a doctor!]{Josephine}" She bit her lip out of agony.

"[Oh...]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Just...Get me something to cover it up with, will you?]{Josephine}" He was shaking, feeling guilty from his actions.

"[I'm sorry. I didn't think--]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Josephine furrowed her brow.

"[I know, I know! Just get me something. Please!]{Josephine}" The Kid quickly tossed her his Squoat doll without second thought.

"[Is this your Worship Do--]{Josephine}"

"[Yeah, it is. It's a little embarrassing, I know.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[I think it's cute...!]{Josephine}" The end of her comment was met with the stinging pressure of his plush doll. Emmett kept his hands to himself, figuring that he had done enough already.

"[Your doll is very personalized, you know that? Makes me a little upset to bleed on it.]{Josephine}" Josephine chuckled softly to herself.

"[I was born into a rich family on Vortox]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett responded.

"[Aristocracy? Oooh. Very nice. Always thought I would make it in the world with a rich man.]{Josephine}" Josephine was clearly joking to lighten up the mood. She smiled over to her partner to show him that it was going to be alright.

"[Always thought I would find myself a strong woman]{Emmett Tawfeek}," Emmett played along.

The pair of them rested together on the floor of the zooming pod. Neither of them particularly knew where they were landing. Neither of them really cared. It was just the current moment that mattered. For the first time in GUYs did either of them find another one of their kind.

"[I'm so glad I met you.]{Josephine}" Josephine had Emmett's Squoat doll tied to her thigh with a cloth from his shirt.

"[And I you, Squosa.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Did you just give me a nickname?]{Josephine}"

"[Oh, I'm sorry.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Squem, you don't have to be sorry about everything, you dork.]{Josephine}" She coyly smirked at him. Emmett folded his hands together and put them in his lap.

"[Sorry for being so uptight. I'm just...nervous.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" It was hard for her to keep in her laughs.

"[What? Want to be more than friends or something?]{Josephine}" She said this in a joking manner, but Josephine was solemn with her concern.

"[Exactly.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Josephine softly sighed and stared up at the blankness of the roof. She had just met him possibly less than a day ago; it was impossible to accurately tell the time after they were knocked out.

"[We're the only two left, huh?]{Josephine}" She tilted her head towards him, resting her cheek on one of his floppy ears. Emmett slowly nodded. "[Squem.]{Josephine}" She rolled towards him and grinned. "[I don't think I have much of a choice then, do I? Not that I mind the thought.]{Josephine}" Emmett sank into his collar, smiling softly to her gorgeous blue eyes. "[Don't push it, cutie. I still need to get to know you.]{Josephine}"

**ONE GUY LATER**

Emmett woke up from his computer desk. He had accidentally fallen asleep while searching for jobs on the Hypernet. He looked around his apartment environment, finding a rather lived-in bed, a mass of paper balls surrounding his trash can, and two dressers. Emmett scratched his beard, having not shaved recently. Outside their room was a small hallway which led to their bathroom and general room. The Kid strode out of his seat into said room, pulled away some curtains and looked out of the tinted window. For miles, all he could see was buildings and roads, each filled to the brim with traffic. He felt exhausted. The neverending rain tended to cause that on a man who had just lost his job. The two Squoatlings resided in one of the tallest complexes on the planet, on the floor second to the penthouse. This was one of the benefits of Josephine's work ethic.

"[Oh, how would she react?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett muttered this to himself as he took out a mug and poured some of his Squodka in it; he was stressed. Soon after this, he wandered back to his room, searching endlessly for a suitable replacement.

After what felt like an hour, Emmett heard his front door open. It must have been Josephine, he thought, him rising from his seat to go and greet her.

"[Why, you're home early.]{Josephine}"

"[Yeah...]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Why's that?]{Josephine}" The purple Squoatling took a seat in the kitchen, laying her stuff down and positioning her legs around the head of the chair.

"[I got laid off from Vegetation Co. Apparently the economy's dwindling and they can't afford me to continue working.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[What? But that's where we get our grass supply.]{Josephine}"

"[I know.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Thinking about the topic of grass, he took out a bundle of the green stuff and split it for the two of them to share.

"[You need to get your butt up there and demand your job back.]{Josephine}"

"[It's not that easy, Squosa--]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Squem, we need the stuff. Remember the last time we ran out?]{Josephine}" Emmett shivered. Although he had no collection of his own strength, he believed she was more monstrous than he was when on The Crave. A severe headbutt to the groin taught him to keep her filled on the plant.

"[I'll go tomorrow, love.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Furgaz gall.]{Josephine}"

"[Furgaz galle.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" (Roughly translates to "[I love you too]{Emmett Tawfeek}".) Josephine rose up from her seat and licked her partner on the cheek.

"[I don't know what I'd do if I lost you again.]{Josephine}"

"[I promise that won't happen again. I'll find a way. Even if the veggie factory fails.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The Kid reassuringly put an arm around her, sighing softly.

"[Remember that guy I was talking about a week ago?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett got out a skillet and a pack of assorted vegetables.

"[You've talked a lot in the last week]{Josephine}," Josephine mused.

"[Hey!]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[But yeah. That Seth dude?]{Josephine}"

"[My old caretaker from a GUY ago. He's finally contacted me.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett cut a hole in the pack and poured its contents into the skillet.

"[That's nice. What did he say?]{Josephine}"

"[Well, he typed in Elfish, somehow. I translated that and it was a long message about how he wants me back.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" She raised an eyebrow.

"[What does that mean?]{Josephine}"

"[He wants us on his ship.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[You mean you, right?]{Josephine}"

"[No, I talked to him about you and I. Apparently they brought in another member while I was gone.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Really?]{Josephine}"

"[Yeah. All Seth told me of him was his romantic affliction with plants.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[That’s… really strange.]{Josephine}" Josephine got up and walked over to him.

"[Squem, I don't think we should leave. I mean, we have a great living quarters here on Daerthlorn. I have a great job in the battle dome.]{Josephine}"

"[Surprised you weren't covered in blood when you came home.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" She smiled at his comment.

"[But look, Squosa. On this ship, we're above the law. We're able to legally hunt people down and plunder for treasure.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett took the skillet off of the burner and started putting some veggies on Josephine's plate.

"[Isn't that dangerous? I mean, if we were to, say, be killed, our actions could cause our culture to vanish.]{Josephine}"

"[We're safer in space than here. Remember, I'm always looking out for us.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" She rolled her eyes and jabbed a fork into a potato-like veggie.

"[I hope you know what you're doing then, 'man of the house'.]{Josephine}" After she said this, Emmett took his fork, having impaled a ketchup-covered, carrot-like veggie, and smeared it on her nose playfully.

"[Squem!]{Josephine}"

**TWO WEEKS LATER**

Emmett gripped his bag tightly as he left the apartment for the last time. He scaled his free digits along the wall as he trailed to the door. Conveniently, it opened as he got to it.

"[You ready, squabe?]{Josephine}" Josephine poked her head into the now-empty apartment cell. "[Damn, you cleaned up quickly.]{Josephine}" She looked around once more, making sure he hadn’t left anything.

"[Yeah, I'm ready. Did you talk to the manager?]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[He's already selling our room as we speak!]{Josephine}" Wow. What a time for the economy to boom. Emmett held out his free hoof for her.

"[Well?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" She grabbed his hand and held it tightly. Josephine was anxious. She couldn't wait to see what was out there waiting for them.

"[Let's go.]{Josephine}" The two Squoatlings left the apartment and headed toward the elevator. The outside represented hope for them. A new beginning. An escape from the sickening lifestyle of corporation and into the free and fertile regions of space.
